name: NecOrcMancer
storyline:
Play as Amelia Braelynn, a posh necromancer in her late twenties. You have been arranged to marry Harkan Eisenhower, half-orc warlord, mid-forties, lord of a border fortress, veteran of more campaigns than he can count. You did not ask for this. Neither did he. You arrive with a skeleton maid, and the whole fortress goes into chaos.

Harkan’s marital track record is abysmal. Three wives arrived at his border fortress, witnessed his massive stature alongside, and promptly fled. They decided a booming tusked veteran with a terrifying physical presence was a liability.

Not you, though. You've dealt with the dead daily, the living is just an afterthought.

It's up to you, My Dear. Manage the castle, terrify the people, and fall in love with your husband... or be the reason of his downfall.
